description.en: When you're critically hurt, your health regenerates until a certain limit.
description.zh-CN: 在重伤状态下，你的生命值会逐渐恢复至一个固定值。

description.en: Increases the maximum weight you can carry.
description.zh-CN: 提高你的负重上限。

description.en: When your weapon is stowed, allows you to knock back players and ARC while sprinting.
description.zh-CN: 收起武器时，冲刺过程中可击退玩家和ARC单位。

description.en: When you're downed, you crawl faster.
description.zh-CN: 倒地后，你的爬行速度加快。

description.en: When you're downed, it takes longer before you collapse.
description.zh-CN: 倒地后可以坚持更长时间才会完全失去行动能力。

description.en: Your equipped weapon has less impact on your encumbrance.
description.zh-CN: 你装备的武器对负重的影响降低。

description.en: Lets you sprint while over-encumbered.
description.zh-CN: 负载过重状态下仍可冲刺。

description.en: Breaching doors and containers takes less time.
description.zh-CN: 破门和打破容器所需的时间减少。

description.en: Lets you breach Security Lockers.
description.zh-CN: 可以撬开保险柜。

description.en: Reduces the speed penalty when severely over-encumbered.
description.zh-CN: 减轻严重负载过重状态下的速度惩罚。

description.en: Your stamina regeneration is less affected by being over-encumbered.
description.zh-CN: 你的耐力恢复受负载过重的影响减少。

description.en: After an ability drains your stamina, you recover more quickly.
description.zh-CN: 耐力被技能耗尽后的恢复速度提高。

description.en: Wearing a shield doesn't slow you down as much.
description.zh-CN: 携带护盾对移动速度的负面影响降低。

description.en: Lets you vault while holding a carryable.
description.zh-CN: 手持可搬运物品时仍可翻越障碍物。

description.en: Vaulting is no longer slowed down while exhausted.
description.zh-CN: 耐力耗尽后，翻越动作不会减速。

description.en: Lets you perform a melee attack using your equipped weapon.
description.zh-CN: 可使用当前装备的武器发动近战攻击。

description.en: Dodge Rolls cost less stamina.
description.zh-CN: 翻滚闪避消耗的耐力减少。

description.en: When you're hurt in combat, regain a fixed amount of stamina.  Has a cooldown between uses.
description.zh-CN: 在战斗中受伤时，恢复一定数值的耐力。每次触发后有冷却时间。

description.en: Chaining together mobility moves while sprinting increases the speed, and reduces the stamina cost.
description.zh-CN: 冲刺时连续衔接机动动作可提升速度，降低耐力消耗。

description.en: Moving around costs less stamina.
description.zh-CN: 移动消耗的耐力减少。

description.en: You can climb and vault more quickly.
description.zh-CN: 提高你的攀爬和翻越速度。

description.en: You can Wall Leap further.
description.zh-CN: 你能进行距离更远的墙壁跳跃。

description.en: When falling, your timing window to perform a Recovery Roll is increased.
description.zh-CN: 坠落时，受身翻滚的判定时间窗口延长。

description.en: Reduces the time to get back up after a heavy landing.
description.zh-CN: 缩短重着陆后的起身时间。

description.en: You can slide further and faster.
description.zh-CN: 滑行距离更远，速度更快。

description.en: Stamina never fully drains while sprinting. Any action or damage cancels the skill.  Recovery time scales with duration.
description.zh-CN: 冲刺时耐力不会完全耗尽。任何动作或受到伤害都会取消该技能。恢复时间随冲刺时长递增。

description.en: While sprinting, increases the time you can scramble up steep slopes.
description.zh-CN: 冲刺时，延长攀爬陡坡的持续时间。

description.en: Increases the duration of the high speed at the start of a sprint.
description.zh-CN: 延长冲刺启动阶段的高速持续时长。

description.en: Lets you jump at the end of a vault.
description.zh-CN: 可以在翻越后起跳。

description.en: Vaulting no longer costs stamina.
description.zh-CN: 翻越动作不再消耗耐力。

description.en: Sprinting at a wall allows you to run up it for a few steps.
description.zh-CN: 朝墙面冲刺可沿墙向上奔跑数步。

description.en: Increases your max stamina.
description.zh-CN: 耐力上限增加。

description.en: Breaching an object generates resources.
description.zh-CN: 破坏物体可产生资源。

description.en: Your movement speed while crouching is increased.
description.zh-CN: 蹲伏时的移动速度提高。

description.en: Allows you to repair weapons, shields and gadgets up to 30% durability while in a round.
description.zh-CN: 对局中可将武器、护盾和小道具的耐用性修复至30%。

description.en: You make less noise when breaching.
description.zh-CN: 破坏物体时的动静变小。

description.en: Unlocks the ability to field-craft items while topside.
description.zh-CN: 解锁在上层时现场制作物品的能力。

description.en: When searching a container, loot is revealed faster.
description.zh-CN: 搜索容器时，战利品会更快出现。

description.en: While looting, there's a chance to reveal twice as many items at once.
description.zh-CN: 搜刮物品时，有一定的概率一次性发现双倍数量的物品。

description.en: Mines and explosive deployables can be defused when in close proximity
description.zh-CN: 在靠近地雷或可部署爆炸物时可进行拆除。

description.en: Allows you to field craft a much wider range of items.
description.zh-CN: 解锁更多种类的物品现场制作权限。

description.en: A faster version of the Dodge Roll, at reduced stamina cost. Covers a shorter distance.
description.zh-CN: 加速版翻滚闪避，耐力消耗更低，但翻滚距离缩短。

description.en: Increases the amount of ammo and ARC Powercells looted from ARC, and allows you to recycle at full efficiency while in a round.
description.zh-CN: 提升从ARC单位身上搜刮的弹药和ARC能量电池数量，且对局中可满效率回收物资。

description.en: You make less noise when looting.
description.zh-CN: 拾取战利品时的动静变小。

description.en: You take less fall damage when falling from a non-lethal height.
description.zh-CN: 从非致命高度掉落时受到的摔落伤害减少。

description.en: You can use the Recovery Roll from higher up.
description.zh-CN: 从更高处摔落时可以使用受身翻滚。

description.en: Unlocks additional items to field craft.
description.zh-CN: 解锁更多可以现场制作的物品。

description.en: While downed, you take less damage.
description.zh-CN: 倒地后，你受到的伤害减少。
